sources.title: Nayib Bukele Ortez: biography and 2024 presidential update
sources.findings: Read CIDOB biography and 2024 update: birth 24 July 1981 San Salvador, business background, GANA 2019 candidacy, FMLN split in 2017; Nuevo Cuscatlán election 11 March 2012, term 1 May 2012–30 April 2015; capital election 1 March 2015, office 1 May for three years; presidential office from 1 June 2019 and second term from 1 June 2024 following 4 February election. Main biography remains dated February 2019 with later prefatory update, not a comprehensive 2026 account. The 2021 Constitutional Chamber ruling is distinct from 2025 reform. Father Armando’s chemistry doctorate does not belong to Nayib. Do not extend old five-year second-term description beyond later reform.

sources.title: February 2024 profile: birth, unfinished law studies, party trajectory and emergency
sources.findings: Read RTVE February 2024 biographical and security sections: exact birth, Palestinian ancestry, young business/advertising work, law studies unfinished, FMLN mayor/GANA presidential candidate. Institution of unfinished studies not independently established in this read text and omitted. Pre-election forecasts and contemporary detention figures are historical, not current totals. No law degree, professional legal qualification or inherited parental doctorate asserted.

sources.title: 31 July 2025 constitutional reform; report updated 1 August
sources.findings: Read Reuters report of 31 July 2025 legislative decision, updated 1 August UTC: unlimited presidential reelection, future six-year terms, no runoff, current term shortened to synchronize 2027 elections. Does not mean automatic third term or a completed future election. Direct assembly and consolidated constitution full opens timed out; no claim of line-by-line statutory audit or exact article list. No invented precise 2027 polling day or unchanged 2029 second-term endpoint.

sources.title: 13 July 2026 report of party nomination for the February 2027 election
sources.findings: Read 13 July 2026 Reuters text on Investing.com: party said late Sunday that Bukele secured uncontested primary nomination, with Félix Ulloa, for February 2027 general election. Timeline uses month to avoid treating publication day as primary date. Party nomination is not general-election victory or separately verified electoral-authority registration. Article author Gerardo Arbaiza; related market news is unrelated.

sources.title: 26 February 2025 financing approval and prior Bitcoin policy reforms
sources.findings: Read IMF 26 February 2025 release as rendered by web tool: 40-month US$1.4 billion arrangement, US$113 million immediate disbursement, prior legal changes making private Bitcoin acceptance voluntary and taxes payable only in USD, public-sector/e-wallet constraints and future commitments. Profile does not imply all US$1.4 billion immediately disbursed, every later pledge fulfilled, or a blanket ban on private Bitcoin ownership. Inaccessible e-library full staff report not claimed read. No current balance-sheet/Bitcoin-reserves audit.

sources.title: 2 November 2026 analysis attributing homicide figures to official statistics
sources.findings: Read substantive 2 November 2026 HRW commentary by Juanita Goeberttus: official homicide rates 7.8/100,000 in 2022 and 1.3 in 2025; significant decline predates emergency. Numbers explicitly attributed to government via HRW, not independently recalculated; avoid definitive causal attribution. Rights concerns described as HRW conclusions, not personal criminal conviction. Caption date corroborates 29 October meeting but copyright year appears 2025, so recent activity grounded in separate completed Andina report.

sources.title: 7 October 2026 investigation of mass trials and defense safeguards
sources.findings: Read 7 October 2026 HRW findings and methodology: 15 defense lawyers, four indictments covering over 600 accused and one decision over 120 people; allegations of weak evidence and inadequate defense in sealed mass trials. No claim to have personally read case files or prove every detainee innocent/guilty. Findings attributed to HRW, not a judgment against Bukele.

sources.title: Completed presidential meeting in San Salvador, 29 October 2026
sources.findings: Read Andina completed-event report dated 29 October 2026: Keiko Fujimori welcomed by Bukele in San Salvador, private bilateral and expanded ministerial meetings. Embedded social post dated 30 October is not a different meeting date. Prior travel permissions and schedules alone not attendance evidence. Discussion is not independently measured security improvement or proof of a later Bukele trip to Peru.

sources.title: World Report 2026: events of 2025, emergency regime and limits of crime statistics
sources.findings: Read relevant World Report 2026 El Salvador sections, covering events of 2025: March 2022 emergency repeatedly extended, due-process restrictions, arbitrary detention/abuse criticism, gang violence decline and public-access/counting limits in homicide statistics. Its statement that 2025 homicide rate was unavailable at writing predates later November 2026 commentary; do not mislabel report-year as all events occurring in 2026. No full underlying statistical dataset inspected.
